verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's virtual mailbox explicitly supports package handling, bundling to save costs, shipping to any address, and mail forwarding/scanning with automation rules, which covers most of the consolidation/forwarding story. However, there is no explicit claim about accepting packages from 'all major carriers' (UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS) or a specific 'hold for pickup' option beyond general mailbox access. Missing for 10: explicit carrier-acceptance guarantees, dedicated hold-for-pickup mechanic, independent corroboration of carrier compatibility.
